== Course of events ==

Having just been sent on their way by the Guardian of the Gate, who removed his green spectacles and wished them well, the Tin Woodman, the Scarecrow, the Cowardly Lion, and Dorothy continue on their journey, with the Scarecrow now aware that he must return to rule the City once Dorothy is safely home. Amid this fresh stretch of travel, the Tin Woodman, the Scarecrow, and the Lion turn to praising Oz, speaking well of him and what he had done for them. Dorothy listens to their praise but does not share it aloud: privately, she forgives Oz for not keeping the promise he had made to her.

The moment passes quietly among the four companions, with no open disagreement or discussion of Dorothy's private feelings. It comes shortly before the Tin Woodman clears a path through a branch and the group arrives at a high wall of white china beyond the wood, carrying them onward into the next stage of their travels together.
